reason: I'm at a party almost every weekend and I already do phone tricks, so a word showing up in my own gallery or calculator is exactly what I'd show off. I'd try the free tricks first, and if one fools my husband I'd pay the 99 that same night.
objection: Even after years of practising I worry I'll mess up the secret part in front of everyone, and installing from a website instead of the App Store and typing my card into some site makes me a bit nervous.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks are clunky or the reveal looks fake on my phone, I wouldn't pay.
